capabilities: Renders the vault as a rotatable, zoomable globe
Places folders as continents and notes as cities
Highlights native Obsidian Search results in the graph
Finds every shortest route between two notes
Saves a fixed layout with camera state and pins
extras: iPhone and iPad use the mobile profile but still need device testing; the optional Follow Search feature reads undocumented Obsidian Search state and can stop working after an Obsidian update. No telemetry, network calls or note-content writes.
problem: Large vaults are hard to navigate spatially, and there is no stable map that keeps notes in the same place while you search, rotate and read.

relations.evidence: The complete data.json map can be carried by Obsidian Sync and restored with Load map.

summary: Fixed-layout 3D globe view of a vault where folders become continents, subfolders countries, notes cities and links roads.
